exceptions.rationale: Vulnerable SDK 1.30.0 is vendored inside the published OpenClaw 2026.9.2 plugin tarballs audited by the reviewed archive graph and cannot be patched through lockfile resolution; upstream resolved it by upgrading the reviewed graph to the 2026.9.5 plugin set.
compensatingControls: The plugin tarballs run inside OpenShell sandboxes governed by nemoclaw-blueprint network policies that restrict egress.
The reviewed npm audit reports this advisory on every code-changing pull request so the exception cannot silently outlive its expiry.
